sanskrit_verse:
शूद्र्यां द्विजातिभिर् जातो न भूमेर् भागम् अर्हति ।
द्विजातिर् आप्नुयात् सर्वम् इति धर्मो व्यवस्थितः ॥
transliteration: śūdryāṃ dvijātibhir jāto na bhūmer bhāgam arhati | dvijātir āpnuyāt sarvam iti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One born of twice-born men with a Śūdra woman shall not inherit land; all property belongs exclusively to the twice-born.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through consecrated lineage, not biological parentage alone
Causation in inheritance is determined by sacramental continuity, not genetic origin
Capacity-based responsibility derives from initiation and Vedic embodiment
Restoration logic requires alignment of ownership with qualified consciousness
Consciousness alignment is secured through ritual purity and scriptural authority
executable_legal_axioms: IF birth involves union between dvija male and śūdra female THEN inheritance rights = null
IF individual has undergone upanayana THEN full property entitlements = true
IF lineage traceability leads to unbroken dvija succession THEN claim precedence = maximum
IF legal dispute arises over inheritance THEN default adjudication vector = consecrated heir
IF no consecrated heir present THEN state acts as custodian until qualified successor identified
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating inheritance disputes involving mixed-caste progeny, the Supreme Court must affirm that only those initiated into the Vedic tradition via formal sacraments possess legitimate proprietary claims. Lineal purity and ritual capacity supersede biological genealogy when determining rightful ownership under Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This rule establishes pramāṇa-based causality where inheritance flows from conscious qualification, not mere physical descent. The sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of rights occurs only upon completion of prescribed rites conferring eligibility. Responsibility lies in maintaining sacred order rather than enforcing penalties against disqualified heirs.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiation Completion Process: Unqualified claimants may undergo purification and study to qualify for partial entitlements
Lineage Clarification Protocol: Trace ancestral line back to last valid upanayana recipient to determine rightful heir
Property Stewardship Assignment: Temporarily assign disputed assets to learned Brahmin caretakers pending resolution
Integrity Reintegration Pathway: Disqualified heirs may assume auxiliary duties within family estate without proprietary rights
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma. This law originates solely from SPH's Avataric Intelligence, not historical interpretation. Justice executed through restoration, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
